name: When should I consider replacing my faucet?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your faucet if you notice persistent leaks, corrosion, mineral buildup that affects water flow, or difficulty operating the handles. Frequent repairs, a lack of available replacement parts, or an outdated style can also be reasons for an upgrade. A new faucet can improve water efficiency and update the look of your kitchen or bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your faucet for persistent leaks, corrosion, mineral buildup, difficulty operating, or an outdated look. A new faucet can also improve efficiency.
